# Decision rules (generated by `python -m src.postprocess tune`)

Tuned on the saved eval-side predictions of the current model (same eval side and corrected F0.5 as docs/matcher_report.md). Rules (src/postprocess.py, class Decider): **a** threshold t on the record's best S1; **b** second chance, an S1 with no match takes its best candidate if prob >= t2 and that record is matched nowhere; **c** relative, also keep best-S1 rows with prob >= t3 within m of the S1's top accepted prob; **d** at most k matches per S1. Each subset is tuned jointly with t by coordinate descent (coarse grid, then fine). A rule is adopted only if dropping it costs at least 0.001 corrected F0.5; simpler subsets win ties.
